description: Use this when someone wants a report, blog post, ebook or whitepaper, slide deck, social card, customer case study or video made from one of their completed GatherHQ studies: creates it and returns its link. All but social cards and a video need a study with real respondents. A simulated study's social cards come from its simulated results, say they are simulated and quote no one. A case study tells one customer's story in their own words, so it needs a study with the brand's own customers, not a research panel. A video story is the study's first social cards in motion, then the brand's logo and site, as MP4s for Reels, LinkedIn and YouTube; it needs a study, with real respondents or simulated, with at least 2 social cards, and it shows only what they say. Put the angle, audience and framing in brief; get study_id from gather_list_studies. Do not use it for copy that is not built from a study.

brief.description: Angle, audience and framing, e.g. "Thought leadership for B2B CMOs, lead with the switching-cost finding".

kind.description: What to create: ebook also for a whitepaper; case-study for one customer's story; video-story for a video of the study's social cards.

study_id.description: The completed study to build from (an id from gather_list_studies).

name: gather_create_content
title: Create content from a study
